summary: 1930s Walker County, Georgia, tower that watched Pigeon Mountain and Lafayette; auctioned without its cab in Feb 2019 and recorded as removed. The record's standing status is wrong.

facts.status_note: Auctioned February 12, 2019 while still standing without its cab, with plans for removal; both registers list it as removed in 2019.

access.note: No standing tower; both registers record removal in 2019.

visit.trail_note: Neither register lists a standing tower to visit.

corrections.why: Both registers list the tower as removed in 2019. The NHLR says it was auctioned on February 12, 2019, while still standing without its cab, with plans for removal.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2016 tower list and the 2017 NHLR registration both predate the 2019 auction. The two 2019 register entries record removal, so 'removed' replaces 'standing'. No source read confirms the tower was taken down.
The NHLR gives 1,141 ft (348 m) for the site; the Georgia tower list gives 1,142 ft. The record has no elevation field, so the story reports both figures.

notes_for_editor: Only the two register pages and one Georgia tower list were found. Web searches for news of the 2019 auction, a GFC record, or a buyer returned nothing relevant. The removal is recorded by both registers but not confirmed on site or by photo. Staffing and fire history: none found. Build date is only 'the 1930s' in both registers. Both registers name the GFC as administrator; the FFLOS entry says 'previously'.
